label: IA-3(3)
title: Dynamic Address Allocation

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Where addresses are allocated dynamically, standardize dynamic address allocation lease information and the lease duration assigned to devices in accordance with {{ insert: param, ia-3.3_prm_1 }} ; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Audit lease information when assigned to a device.

guidance: The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) is an example of a means by which clients can dynamically receive network address assignments.

params.label: organization-defined lease information and lease duration
lease information
guidelines: lease information to be employed to standardize dynamic address allocation for devices is defined;

params.label: lease duration
guidelines: lease duration to be employed to standardize dynamic address allocation for devices is defined;
